name: barbarian_warrior
description: a Barbarian Warrior, a hunched green-skinned orc: olive-green skin, small orange eyes, jutting lower tusks, pointed ears, a black topknot tied with a rust-red band, dark fur-and-leather shoulder mantle and vest, a necklace of bone teeth, a brown belt over a ragged red loincloth, fur-topped brown leather boots, a wooden club studded with grey iron spikes in his RIGHT hand and a round hide shield with a brown rim and a red handprint on his LEFT arm
hands: the spiked club stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and the hide shield on his left arm on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the spiked club is lifted beside the head with its spiked head pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the club hand behind the head and the spiked club hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, the hide shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the club arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the spiked club is level, its spiked head pointing to the right
strike.4: contact: club arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the spiked club smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, tusks bared, the hide shield swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the club carries on down until its spiked head nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the topknot trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the spiked club comes back up on the near side toward the ready angle, the hide shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (club arm thrown up and out to the left, the hide shield flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the spiked club dipping, the hide shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, club arm flung up, the hide shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the spiked club lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the club's spiked head resting on the ground at the lower-right, shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the spiked club slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the topknot on the ground; the spiked club lies on the ground at the lower-right; the round hide shield lies flat beside him
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the spiked club and the hide shield on the ground beside him
